summary: Slice S6: Runs home at /projects (Needs you by served activity.attention.kind question/pane/approval, Running, Recent = finished within 7 days newest first, compact project cards) from run lists only; RunRow (one link in an li, data-run-id/data-status/data-attention, name starts with run id, stacks at 390 px); project page grouped by feature under workflows-list; feature page keeps run-list li rows with Current definition in a closed details; reordered workflow title rule; ServedRunContext from ProjectsView feeds LiveStatus (controller suffix, not_running only after 15 s), CommandBlock (RUN=<run_dir> line) and NowBanner (served question/answered/controller-stopped re-derivation). Pure helpers in src/projects/lists.ts with 27 unit tests. Fixtures ux-lists.ts (8 runs, live ui.questions.json, pane event, dead controller PID, viewer.expose_run_dir); ux-lists.spec.ts with [scenario:runs-home] and [scenario:served-activity]; projects.spec.ts:149 migrated (open the current-definition summary). Red recorded first in both phases (unit: module missing; browser: no needs-you rows, banner showed the export's stale question). Executed and green: npm run build; npm run lint; npx tsx --test tests/unit/lists.test.ts (27/27); npm run test:unit (298/298); npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts (52/52); ux-lists.spec.ts + projects.spec.ts worker and candidate (12/12 each, JSON reports pass workflow check-report for lists); full project-workflows suite worker 53/53 and candidate 53/53. Handoff: docs/handoff/ux-s6.md. Nothing committed.
open_assumptions: When served activity disagrees with the export (question answered or asked in the live questions file, or controller not running for 15 s while running), NowBanner re-derives from served fields alone (deriveNow with no events), so that banner lacks the event-derived reason and the question number/text; document.title, graph and Steps attention still use RunView's export-derived attention because RunView is not edited.
A run page titles a generic-named workflow by its own run's activity.feature (it reads no run list); lists and the feature page use the latest run's feature.
Needs you is sorted longest waiting first, Running by latest activity; the PRD does not specify order.
The project page shows the first run page per workflow ('N+ runs' when more exist) and runs of any age; its heading reads '<project>: features'.
Runs home pages each workflow's runs only while the last run read is inside the 7-day window, so an old still-running run on a later page is listed only on its project and feature pages.
